head: Packed for It combines trip planning and packing lists
dek: Packed for It keeps a cruise, flight, road trip or RV trip in one place, with people, pets, routes, stays, documents, weather and packing details connected. It was #25 among paid Travel apps on the US App Store on 6 November.
details: It came out on 5 November and costs $14.99, by Wendy Lee Reifel.
means: If your trip plans live in five apps, this puts them together.
todo: Find Packed for It in the App Store.
thumb_words: PLAN AND PACK IN ONE APP
